name: Rumble ~Bankara Yashahime~
source:
There was a hero once who saved the school from violence and it returned to a peaceful routine. His name was soon forgotten.
Nowadays there's a new threat and those who still remember that hero try to find a new hero for this task. And the search is finally over. That's you!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
曾经有一名英雄将学校从暴力中拯救出来，校园重新恢复了平静。可没过多久，他的名字便被人遗忘。

如今，新的威胁出现了。仍然记得那位英雄的人试图寻找新的英雄来完成这项任务，而寻找终于有了结果——那个人就是你！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
